frames.u: Stage 4 is where it gets personal.
Kilometre one. Legs made of wood.
Kilometre six. Suddenly you could run forever.
In detail. Toast, eggs, then more toast.
The last three. Nobody can explain it.
Sent from the couch, ten minutes later.

reel1.caption:
Every long run goes through the same five stages.
Wood legs, false hope, breakfast plans, the longest three kilometres on earth, then signing up for more.
Which race are you training for? Tell me below.

#longrun #saturdayrun #runnerlife #runninghumor #PaceShark

frames.u: You won't win. Run smarter instead.
Slower into the wind is normal. Same effort, honest work.
Then it pushes you home when your legs are tired.
Quick, small steps and a slight lean. Stay low.
Wind dries you out before you feel thirsty.

reel2.caption:
The wind always wins. Your job is to run smart anyway.
Run by effort, start into it, and let it blow you home.
Save this for your next long run.

#runninginthewind #runningtips #weekendrun #roadrunning #PaceShark

slides.sub: Your club does number 4 every single week. Swipe.

slides.title: THE MEETING POINT
slides.head: Start time is 6:00. Leaving time is 6:12.
slides.body: Someone is always still parking. Someone is always tying a shoe.

slides.title: THE EASY PACE
slides.head: "Nice and easy today, everyone."
slides.body: Three kilometres later the front group is doing tempo and nobody admits it.

slides.title: THE REGROUP
slides.head: Waiting at the top of the hill.
slides.body: The best part of a club run: nobody gets left behind, and everybody catches their breath.

slides.title: THE EXTRA LOOP
slides.head: Someone runs laps of the car park.
slides.body: Their watch says 19.6 km. It must say 20. You understand completely.

slides.title: THE BIG PROMISE
slides.head: "Let's all do a race together."
slides.body: Said every Saturday. One week it actually happens, and that's the best race of the year.

slides.sub: The ones who wait for you at the top of the hill.
